title: Consolidate per-vertex part/body correspondence evaluation
description:
AppearanceBake and implicit-surface influence-domain resolution independently evaluate the same generated vertices against the same Body and resolved part SDF programs. Design one authoritative correspondence result or reusable evaluation pass that can supply nearest-body/part ownership to both consumers without changing tie semantics, mirrored-domain rules, or gradient coloring. Measure before/after because this path is a plausible secondary AppearanceBake and binding hotspot. Do not build a generic IR or service layer merely for abstraction; keep the result specific to generated-surface correspondence.
